eth_phy_10g_rx_frame_sync.summary: 10GBASE-R block sync: counts valid and invalid 2-bit sync headers over 64-block windows to acquire or lose block lock, pulsing SERDES bitslip with hold-off timing until aligned.

blocks.name: Block lock controller
blocks.description: Lock state machine driven by sync header validity

anchors.name: rx_block_lock_reg
anchors.why: Lock state: set after clean window, cleared on excess invalid headers

anchors.name: rx_block_lock
anchors.why: Block lock status output

anchors.name: serdes_rx_hdr
anchors.why: Received sync header checked for valid 01/10 patterns

blocks.name: Header counters
blocks.description: Window and invalid-header counters deciding lock acquisition and loss

anchors.name: sh_count_reg
anchors.why: Sync header window counter; overflow evaluates lock

anchors.name: sh_invalid_count_reg
anchors.why: Invalid header counter; overflow drops lock and triggers bitslip

blocks.name: Bitslip control
blocks.description: Generates bitslip pulse and enforces high/low hold-off timing

anchors.name: serdes_rx_bitslip
anchors.why: Bitslip command pulse to SERDES on lost alignment

anchors.name: bitslip_count_reg
anchors.why: Timer for bitslip high and low hold-off cycles

eth_phy_10g_rx_ber_mon.summary: 10G PHY bit-error-rate monitor counting invalid sync headers per 125us window and flagging high BER when 16 errors occur.

blocks.name: ber_monitor
blocks.description: Window timer and error counter deciding the high BER flag.

anchors.name: time_count_reg
anchors.why: 125us window timer; expiry resets error count and clears flag.

anchors.name: ber_count_reg
anchors.why: Counts invalid headers in window; reaching 15 sets high BER.

anchors.name: rx_high_ber
anchors.why: High BER indication output, copy of rx_high_ber_reg.

ungrouped_anchors.name: serdes_rx_hdr
ungrouped_anchors.why: Received sync header checked against SYNC_CTRL/SYNC_DATA to detect errors.

eth_phy_10g_rx_watchdog.summary: 10GBASE-R receive watchdog: a 125us interval timer evaluates control-header sightings and block-error counts, counting bad/good intervals to request SERDES reset or assert rx_status.

blocks.name: Interval timer
blocks.description: 125us periodic evaluation timer

anchors.name: time_count_reg
anchors.why: 125us interval down-counter; expiry triggers evaluation of all counters

blocks.name: Interval monitor
blocks.description: Collects header sightings and block errors within an interval

anchors.name: saw_ctrl_sh_reg
anchors.why: Records a control sync header seen during current interval

anchors.name: block_error_count_reg
anchors.why: Saturating count of bad blocks/sequence errors per interval

anchors.name: serdes_rx_hdr
anchors.why: Sync header compared with SYNC_CTRL to set saw_ctrl_sh

anchors.name: rx_bad_block
anchors.why: Bad block indication incrementing block_error_count

anchors.name: rx_sequence_error
anchors.why: Sequence error indication incrementing block_error_count

anchors.name: rx_block_lock
anchors.why: Block lock input gating header/error monitoring and clearing status

blocks.name: Health decision
blocks.description: Bad/good interval counters producing reset request and status

anchors.name: error_count_reg
anchors.why: Counts consecutive bad intervals; saturation requests SERDES reset

anchors.name: status_count_reg
anchors.why: Counts consecutive good intervals; saturation asserts rx_status

anchors.name: serdes_rx_reset_req
anchors.why: Reset request pulse to SERDES after repeated bad intervals

anchors.name: rx_status
anchors.why: Link-good status output from rx_status_reg

eth_phy_10g_rx_if.summary: 10GBASE-R receive interface: optionally bit-reverses and pipelines SERDES data, descrambles it with a 58-bit LFSR into registered encoded output, and runs block sync, BER monitor and watchdog children plus an optional PRBS31 error checker.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_data_int
anchors.why: Aligned/pipelined SERDES data feeding descrambler and PRBS checker.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_hdr_int

blocks.name: Descrambler

anchors.name: encoded_rx_hdr

blocks.name: Block sync and monitors

anchors.name: rx_status
